text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected in eu-west-1 for inference traffic. P95 latency spike > 1s. Auto-escalation to oncall.

incident-bot: Summary: metric=service.5xx_rate region=eu-west-1 threshold=0.02 current=0.064 window=5m

emma-se: saw this, paging @raj (sre oncall) and @benji (runtime).

raj: on it. grabbing logs + routing stats. any customer reports?

sasha: product ops reporting spikes in support queues for customers in EU — a couple of high-traffic tenants saw degraded responses. Not full outage but high error and multi-second tails.

benji: quick check — routing decisions look unusual. I'm seeing many route_decision=spillover entries targeting fallback model variant. hypothesis: primary model pool saturated, routing policy spilled to fallback that has incompatible kv-cache layout causing errors/timeouts.

benji: sharing sample logs (trunc'd):
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] req_id=abc123 region=eu-west-1 route_decision=spillover dest=eu-nonprimary fallback_model=redwood-7b-q8_0 latency_ms=1187 status=502 err=kv_cache_miss
[2026-03-15T09:12:04Z] req_id=abc124 region=eu-west-1 route_decision=spillover dest=eu-nonprimary fallback_model=redwood-7b-q8_0 latency_ms=1342 status=504 err=kv_cache_eviction
[2026-03-15T09:12:05Z] req_id=abc125 region=eu-west-1 route_decision=local_primary dest=eu-primary model=redwood-13b latency_ms=98 status=200
```

emma-se: @benji do we have a quick mitigation? can we stop spillover until we confirm compatibility?

benji: yes we can flip policy to disable regional spillover or change fallback selector. proposing: set routing.policy.region_spillover=false for eu-west-1 and force fallback_model_selector=none (i.e., return 503 instead of routing to incompatible fallback) while we investigate.

tori: +1 to preventing bad fallback. better to fail closed than route to a model that crashes.

raj: can we do temporary pinning? we have enough capacity in eu-primary if we throttle bursty tenants. we should apply a traffic-shaping rule and disable spillover. I'll coordinate with ops.

alice.m: ping @ops-bot for the action and record the change. we need audit log.

ops-bot: Running change: update-routing-policy --region eu-west-1 --set region_spillover=false --author raj --run-id=run-7721

ops-bot: Change applied. audit_id=audit-7721. New policy: region_spillover=false.

benji: confirming metrics — 3m after policy change p95 latency in eu-west-1 fell from ~1.2s to ~210ms, 5xx rate down to 0.015.

incident-bot: NOTE: mitigation in place. ticket created ID=INC-2026-0315-41. Please collect timeline and logs; this thread will be used for in-incident RCA coordination.

sasha: customer impact notes: At peak ~08:50-09:20 UTC, 4 enterprise tenants saw elevated latencies/errors. SLA hit potential for one high-volume tenant. I filed a support alert and outbound comms draft in /confluence/incidents/INC-2026-0315-41 (pending).

benji: starting timeline from logs:
- 2026-03-15T08:47:12Z: first small spike in queue depth eu-primary
- 2026-03-15T08:50:02Z: routing policy autospill triggered (threshold breached)
- 2026-03-15T09:11:55Z: elevated 5xx observed, Incident bot alerted
- 2026-03-15T09:14:30Z: mitigation applied (region_spillover=false)
- 2026-03-15T09:18:00Z: metrics trending back to baseline

raj: adding quick hypothesis list:
1) autospillover triggered too aggressively — threshold tuning bug or misread of queue signals.
2) fallback selection returned an incompatible model variant (quantization/profile mismatch) — causing KV cache misses and 5xx.
3) routing cache staleness -> misroutes (policy mismatch between control plane and dataplane).
4) capacity flapping in eu-primary (pod churn) causing transient overload and spillover loop.

emma-se: we need owners for each hypothesis. propose: benji -> hypothesis 2+4 (runtime + model compatibility), tori -> hypothesis 1 (policy thresholds), raj -> hypothesis 3 (control/dataplane sync). sasha -> customer impact and comms. alice.m -> overall RCA lead.

alice.m: ack. output: RCA doc owner assigned to me. timeline + logs need to be pasted here or linked. we should capture config versions.

benji: pulling config/version details:
```
routing-policy-service v=2.14.3 commit=ad9f2b3
spillover-thresholds: queue_depth=1000, p50_delay_ms=200, consecutive_windows=2
fallback-selector v=1.7.0 commit=b1c9
model-registry: redwood-7b-q8_0 profile=kv-legacy
```

tori: looking at the thresholds, consecutive_windows=2 is pretty aggressive for bursty traffic — might be oscillating. also noticed change to policy in deployment pipeline 2026-03-10 that lowered queue_depth threshold from 1500 -> 1000.

raj: logs from control plane around the time show heartbeats missing from some eu-primary pods (pod restart noise). snippet: 
```
[2026-03-15T08:49:58Z] cp-heartbeat pod=eu-primary-12 status=unreachable
[2026-03-15T08:50:01Z] cp-heartbeat pod=eu-primary-7 status=restart
[2026-03-15T08:50:02Z] route_decision policy=autospill -> spillover
```

benji: that supports hypothesis 4 -> 1 chain. crash/restarts reduced capacity, autospill threshold too low, fallback selection defaulted to a new quantized variant that doesn't share runtime cache layout. we need to prevent fallback to incompatible model families.

emma-se: short-term followups (in-incident):
- keep region_spillover=false until we deploy compatibility checks (owner benji)
- rollback threshold change if it's causing oscillation (owner tori)
- add guard in fallback-selector to only pick models that match kv_cache_layout (owner benji)
- run reconciliation between control-plane policy versions and dataplane (owner raj)

sasha: I'll prepare customer comms and coordinate credits for affected tenants — need confirmed timeline and impacted request ids.

alice.m: handing off to post-incident RCA phase. final oncall notes: @raj you keep ownership of postmortem infra checks; @benji and @tori work on fixes; @sasha will handle comms. We will have a triage sync 11:30 UTC.

raj: handing over monitoring to daytime SRE. I'll post runbook actions and logs to the incident ticket.

ops-bot: Audit: routing-policy update run-7721 by raj at 2026-03-15T09:14:30Z. revert-able=true.

benji: quick reproducible test to validate hypothesis 2: simulate request with kv cache state difference, confirm fallback model returns 502. test script result: reproduces. Created PR to add model compatibility check in fallback-selector: PR#4456.

tori: created rollback PR to restore queue_depth threshold to 1500: PR#4458. will expedite review.

emma-se: moving this to incident-retrospective channel once RCA draft is ready. thx everyone who jumped in.

alice.m: closing incident mitigation loop. final notes: cause = combination of pod restarts (capacity loss) + aggressive spillover threshold + incompatible fallback model variant -> misroutes and 5xx. Action items captured in ticket INC-2026-0315-41.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated. Postmortem required. Checklist created: postmortem-due 2026-03-22.

sasha: added impacted tenants list and draft comms to ticket. will circulate before sending.

benji: adding logs, config diffs, and PR links to the RCA doc.

alice.m: thanks team. leaving the channel for followups in the postmortem doc.

raj: final handoff: daytime SRE assigned - oncall slack: @day-sre. any urgent followups ping me.

ops-bot: Thread archived to INC-2026-0315-41 after 2026-03-15T11:00:00Z.
